* Scheduled over a range
SCHEDULED: <2026-05-04 Mon>--<2026-05-06 Wed>

* Deadline range with times
DEADLINE: <2026-05-04 Mon 09:00>--<2026-05-06 Wed 17:00>

* Inactive closed range
CLOSED: [2026-05-04 Mon]--[2026-05-06 Wed]

* Range whose first half carries a repeater
SCHEDULED: <2026-05-04 Mon +1w>--<2026-05-06 Wed>

* Two keywords on one line, the first a range
SCHEDULED: <2026-05-04 Mon>--<2026-05-06 Wed> DEADLINE: <2026-05-08 Fri>

* A half that is not a timestamp stays outside it
SCHEDULED: <2026-05-04 Mon>--<later>

* A dash run that is not a range
SCHEDULED: <2026-05-04 Mon>--
